name: @magic-seven-ai/magic-seven-mcp

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Returns the timeline with tracks, clips, scenes, markers, and transitions. Includes _v for stale-data detection. Compact (default) omits frame fields. Minimal strips clips to clipId + timelineIn/Out only (~60% smaller than compact). Use `include` to request specific sections, `trackIds` to filter tracks, `clipLimit`/`clipOffset` to paginate clips (default 50/track), `timeRangeStart`/`timeRangeEnd` to scope results to a time window (seconds).

detail.description: Level of detail for clip data. "minimal" strips clips to clipId + timelineIn/Out only (~60% smaller than compact). "compact" (default) omits frame fields and originalSource bounds. "full" returns everything.

include.description: Whitelist of sections to return. Omit to return all sections. Example: ["tracks", "scenes"] returns only tracks and scenes.

markerType.description: Filter markers by type. Omit to return all markers. Markers without a type are treated as "user".

trackIds.description: Filter to specific track IDs. Omit to return all tracks.

clipLimit.description: Max clips per track (default 50). Set 0 for unlimited.

clipOffset.description: Skip this many clips per track (for pagination).

timeRangeStart.description: Only return items overlapping after this time (seconds).

timeRangeEnd.description: Only return items overlapping before this time (seconds).

tools.name: get_playhead_position
tools.description: Returns the current playhead position in seconds and timecode (HH:MM:SS:FF).

tools.name: get_project_files
tools.description: Returns metadata for all files: id, name, type, duration, state, hasTranscription.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Returns the current undo/redo history. Each action includes: id, type, timestamp, actor (user/agent), and payload.

tools.name: get_timeline_version
tools.description: Returns a lightweight version counter and basic stats (~80 bytes). Call this before re-fetching get_timeline — if the version matches what you already have, your data is current.

tools.name: get_timeline_summary
tools.description: Lightweight timeline overview: per-track stats, scene list, and counts (~300 bytes). Use before fetching full clip data to decide which tracks/scenes to drill into.

tools.name: add_clip
tools.description: Add a video/audio clip to the timeline. Provide at minimum a fileId (from get_project_files). Position, sourceIn/Out, and trackId are optional. Set append: true to add after the last clip on the track (no position needed). overlapBehavior: DISALLOW (default, rejects), TRIM_OVERLAPPED (trims existing), TRIM_TO_FIT (trims new clip). When an explicit position is within 2 frames (~33ms at 59.94fps) of an existing clip boundary on the target track, it magnet-snaps to that boundary to prevent blank-frame gaps in render. To append cleanly use append: true. Pass snapToFrame: false to disable all snapping for sub-frame precision. Response includes magnetSnapped: true (and snappedToClipId, originalPosition) when this snap fires.

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

append.description: When true, appends the clip to the end of the track instead of placing at a specific position.

trackIndex.description: Target track by index (0-based). Alternative to trackId.

tools.name: delete_clip
tools.description: Delete a clip from the timeline by its clip ID.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to a new position on the timeline. Omit targetTrackId to move within the same track. Provide targetTrackId to move to a different track. When newTimelineIn is within 2 frames (~33ms at 59.94fps) of a neighboring clip boundary, it magnet-snaps to that boundary to prevent blank-frame gaps. Pass snapToFrame: false to disable all snapping for sub-frame precision. Response includes magnetSnapped: true when this snap fires.

newTimelineIn.description: New timeline start position in seconds

targetTrackId.description: Target track ID (omit to stay on same track)

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim a clip by adjusting its source in/out points (non-destructive). Specify handle ("left" or "right") to indicate which edge. Cannot trim beyond originalSourceIn/Out bounds.

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split a clip at a timeline position. Mode: "split" (two clips), "keep-left", "keep-right". Position must be within the clip's timeline bounds.

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: set_clip_speed
tools.description: Change the playback speed of a clip. Speed range: 0.1 (10% slow-mo) to 10.0 (10x fast-mo). 1.0 = normal speed. Adjusts timelineOut to reflect new duration.

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: duplicate_clip
tools.description: Duplicate a clip. Places the copy immediately after the original, or at targetPosition.

targetPosition.description: Target timeline position for the copy (seconds)

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: extract_audio
tools.description: Extract the audio from a video clip into a new audio track. Creates a new audio track immediately above the source track with a copy of the clip.

clipId.description: Video clip ID to extract audio from

tools.name: reorder_clips
tools.description: Reorder clips within a single track by moving a clip from one index to another.

trackId.description: Track ID containing the clips to reorder

tools.name: add_audio_clip_auto_track
tools.description: Add an audio clip and automatically create/use an audio track linked to the specified video track. This is the preferred way to add audio clips — it handles audio track management automatically.

targetVideoTrackId.description: Video track ID to associate the audio track with

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: batch_add_clips
tools.description: Add multiple clips to the timeline sequentially. Optionally adds transitions between clips. Returns clip IDs. Use this instead of looping over add_clip(append: true). Clips are appended directly to the end of the previous clip, so no gaps are ever introduced.

clips.description: Array of clip specs to add sequentially (1-50)

trackId.description: Target track ID. If omitted, appends to the first video track.

transitionType.description: If set, adds this transition type between all placed clips after placement.

transitionDurationFrames.description: Duration of transitions in frames (default: 30). Only used if transitionType is set.

snapToFrame.description: Snap timeline positions to frame boundaries (default: true). Set false for sub-frame precision.

tools.name: batch_delete_clips
tools.description: Delete multiple clips from the timeline in a single operation. Processes deletions sequentially and reports individual results. Maximum 100 clips per call.

clipIds.description: Array of clip IDs to delete (1-100)

tools.name: set_clip_volume_envelope
tools.description: Set the volume envelope (keyframes) for a clip. Nodes define volume at specific source times with linear interpolation between them. Pass an empty array to reset to default (full volume). Volume range: 0.0 (silence) to 1.5 (~+3.5dB).

time.description: Position in source time (seconds from start of source media)

nodes.description: Volume keyframe nodes sorted by source time. Empty array = reset to full volume.

tools.name: get_clip_volume_envelope
tools.description: Get the current volume envelope (keyframes) for a clip. Returns the array of nodes with time and gain, or an empty array if no envelope is set.

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add a new track to the timeline. Specify type ("video" or "audio"), an optional display name, and an optional index for positioning.

index.description: Position index for the new track

name.description: Human-readable track name (e.g. "B-roll"). If omitted, defaults to "Video Track N" / "Audio Track N".

isSpeech.description: Mark as speech track to show transcript text instead of waveform (audio tracks only)

tools.name: delete_track
tools.description: Delete a track from the timeline. All clips on the track will be removed. Cannot delete locked tracks.

tools.name: reorder_tracks
tools.description: Change the vertical position of a track on the timeline.

newIndex.description: New position index for the track

tools.name: update_track
tools.description: Update track properties: display name, visibility, audio mute, and volume. Cannot change lock state.

name.description: Human-readable track name (e.g. "B-roll"). Pass an empty string to clear and show "Untitled Track".

audioVolume.description: Track audio volume level (0 = silent, 1 = full volume)

isSpeech.description: Enable/disable speech mode (shows transcript text on audio clips instead of waveform)

tools.name: add_scenes
tools.description: Add one or more scenes to the timeline as a single undoable action.

metadata.description: Structured metadata (visual, audio, motion profiles, transcript, faces, etc.)

tools.name: update_scene
tools.description: Update an existing scene's properties (name, color, time range, description).

metadata.description: Structured metadata (visual, audio, motion profiles, transcript, faces, etc.)

tools.name: delete_scenes
tools.description: Delete one or more scenes from the timeline as a single undoable action.

sceneIds.description: Array of scene IDs to delete (1-500)

tools.name: add_annotations
tools.description: Add one or more track-level annotations as a single undoable action. Annotations are time-range labels scoped to a specific track.

trackId.description: Track ID this annotation belongs to

name.description: Annotation name (auto-generated as "Annotation N" if omitted)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., "#4ECDC4"), auto-assigned if omitted

tools.name: update_annotation
tools.description: Update an existing track annotation's properties (name, color, time range, description).

tools.name: delete_annotations
tools.description: Delete one or more track annotations as a single undoable action.

annotationIds.description: Array of annotation IDs to delete (1-500)

tools.name: get_track_annotations
tools.description: Get annotations for a specific track or all tracks. When trackId is provided, all matching annotations are returned by default (the build_track_from_annotations workflow needs every entry); pass summary=true to receive only annotationId/trackId/name/timeline range to keep large tracks within the token budget. Pass excludeFilled=true (with trackId) to drop annotations whose time range is already fully covered by clips on the track — the response reports `excludedFilled` count alongside `count` and `total`. When trackId is omitted, results are paginated (default limit 50) — use limit/offset and inspect total to detect truncation.

trackId.description: Track ID to filter by (omit for all annotations)

limit.description: Maximum number of annotations to return when trackId is omitted (default 50). Ignored when trackId is provided.

offset.description: Number of annotations to skip when trackId is omitted (default 0). Ignored when trackId is provided.

summary.description: When true, returns only annotationId, trackId, name, color, and timelineIn/Out per annotation (no description or metadata). Use this on tracks with many annotations to stay within the token budget; fetch full detail with summary=false for the specific annotations you act on.

excludeFilled.description: When true (and trackId is provided), drops annotations whose [timelineIn, timelineOut] range is already fully covered by clips on the track. Coverage is computed server-side via the same gap detection used by find_gaps. Ignored when trackId is omitted (fill state is track-scoped). Default false.

tools.name: decide_shot
tools.description: Resolve a single annotation to a concrete (fileId, sourceIn, sourceOut) using the deterministic ranker. Returns either { decision } with a placement ready for add_clip, or { failure } with a reason. Costs zero LLM tokens — runs entirely in the parent process. Call this BEFORE searching when you're trying to fill an annotation; only fall back to search_project / search_footage_semantic / get_top_clips_global on failure.

annotationId.description: Annotation ID for the result payload.

trackId.description: Track to place the clip on.

annotationName.description: Annotation name — primary search query input.

annotationMetadata.description: Optional annotation.metadata (faces, tags, audioProfile, motionProfile, transcript, etc.).

minScore.description: Optional minimum fused score below which the ranker emits failure (default 0.15).

tools.name: update_marker
tools.description: Update an existing marker's properties (name, position, color, description).

tools.name: delete_markers
tools.description: Delete one or more markers from the timeline. Processes deletions sequentially and reports results.

markerIds.description: Array of marker IDs to delete (1-500)

tools.name: add_markers
tools.description: Add one or more markers to the timeline. Returns array of created marker IDs.

type.description: Marker type — "beat" for beat-detected markers, "user" for manual markers

tools.name: add_transition
tools.description: Add a transition effect between two adjacent clips on the same track.

tools.name: update_transition
tools.description: Update an existing transition's properties (type, duration, parameters).

tools.name: delete_transition
tools.description: Delete a transition from the timeline.

tools.name: batch_add_transitions
tools.description: Add transitions between ALL adjacent clips on a track. Finds every pair of adjacent clips and adds the specified transition type between them. Useful for quickly adding consistent transitions across an entire track.

trackId.description: Track ID to add transitions on

type.description: Transition type to add between all adjacent clips

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last editor action.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone editor action.

tools.name: flush_changes
tools.description: Flush any accumulated (batched) changes to the timeline. Call this after performing multiple rapid edits to ensure all changes are committed to history. Useful after batch operations or when you want to ensure the timeline state is fully persisted.

tools.name: import_files
tools.description: Import local media files (video, audio, image) into the open project via absolute paths.

filePaths.description: Absolute paths to local media files

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a file from the project. If the file is used in timeline clips, those clips will be automatically removed first. This action is irreversible. You must set confirm to true to proceed.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: update_file_local_path
tools.description: Update the local disk path for a file. Use this when source files have been moved to a new location. The new path must point to an existing file on disk.

localPath.description: New absolute path to the file on disk

tools.name: retry_file_processing
tools.description: Retry processing for a file in "failed" state. Triggers the S3 pipeline again.

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: Returns the current page (projects_list or project_editor), project context if in the editor, whether editor tools are available, and app update status when an update is available/downloading/downloaded. Call this first to understand context before using other tools. Editor tools (timeline, clips, tracks, scenes, markers, transitions, history, files) require a project to be open. Check the "update" field — if present with status "downloaded", install it at your next stopping point.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists all of the user's projects with id, name, createdAt, and fileCount. Use the project id with open_project to navigate to a specific project.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Navigates to a project by its ID, opening it in the editor. After calling this, wait a few seconds for the editor to fully load before using editor tools (timeline, clips, tracks, scenes, markers, transitions, history, files). Use get_app_status to confirm the editor is ready.

tools.name: navigate_to_projects
tools.description: Navigates back to the projects list page. After calling this, editor tools (timeline, clips, tracks, scenes, markers, transitions, history, files) will no longer be available until you open a project with open_project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a new project with the given name. By default, navigates to the new project after creation. If navigateToProject is true (default), wait a few seconds for the editor to load before using editor tools.

name.description: The name for the new project

navigateToProject.description: Whether to navigate to the new project after creation (default: true)

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename a project. Provide the project ID and the new name.

name.description: The new name for the project

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project. This action is irreversible. You must set confirm to true to proceed. If the deleted project is currently open, navigate away first or after.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: render_timeline
tools.description: Render the current timeline to a video file. Requires original source files to be available on disk (imported via Electron). A project must be open in the editor with clips on the timeline. This call blocks until rendering completes. Use get_render_status to poll progress from a separate request. After this tool completes, the render modal remains open — use control_modal to dismiss it.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the output video file (e.g., /Users/me/Desktop/output.mp4)

quality.description: Render quality: draft (fast), standard (balanced), high (slow). Default: standard

encoder.description: Video encoder. "auto" (default) prefers hardware, falls back to software silently. "software" forces CPU x264. Do not specify a named hardware encoder unless get_encoder_info confirms it is in availableEncoders — the render will fail if unsupported.

tools.name: get_render_status
tools.description: Get current rendering progress and status.

tools.name: get_encoder_info
tools.description: Get available video encoders and hardware acceleration status.

tools.name: get_file_analysis
tools.description: Fetch AI analysis data for files (short_summary, long_summary, top_clips, optional index). Set includeIndex: true to include per-second frame descriptions. Only files with state "processed" have analysis data.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to get analysis for (max 10 per call). Use get_project_files to find available file IDs.

includeIndex.description: Include the second-by-second index field. Default: false (saves significant context). Set to true when you need to search for specific moments in footage (e.g., finding 'the couple's first kiss'). WARNING: index data can be 30-100KB per file.

tools.name: get_footage_overview
tools.description: Returns an overview of footage files combining analysis, face data, and transcription status. "standard" (default, max 10): full top_clips and face time ranges. "compact" (max 50): truncated summary and face names only.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to get overview for. Max 10 for standard detail, max 50 for compact. Use get_project_files to find available file IDs.

detail.description: Level of detail. "standard" (default, max 10): full top_clips and face ranges. "compact" (max 50): truncated summary, best score, face names only.

tools.name: get_top_clips_global
tools.description: Aggregate the best clips across all project files, sorted by quality score. "compact" (default): top clips + stats. "full": adds per-file summaries. Pass `query` to filter clips by lexical match against the clip description text before quality-score ranking — use this to find clips matching a specific request.

query.description: Optional search query. When provided, filters top_clips to those whose description/reasoning text matches the query (case-insensitive partial keyword match), then ranks by match strength and quality score.

topN.description: Number of top clips to return (default 20, max 100).

minScore.description: Minimum quality score filter. Only clips with score >= this value are included.

detail.description: Level of detail. "compact" (default): top clips + summary stats. "full": adds per-file summaries.

tools.name: get_editor_settings
tools.description: Get current editor settings including zoom level, snapping, and overlap behavior.

tools.name: set_editor_settings
tools.description: Update editor settings. Provide only the settings you want to change. Use resetToDefaults to restore all settings to their default values.

overlapBehavior.description: Default overlap behavior for clip placement

showSubtitles.description: Show subtitles/closed captions on video player

resetToDefaults.description: Reset all settings to defaults (ignores other params)

tools.name: get_file_usage
tools.description: Check how a file is used in the timeline. Returns whether the file is used, the number of clips using it, and details about each clip placement.

fileId.description: File ID to check usage for

tools.name: find_gaps
tools.description: Find empty gaps (spaces without clips) on a specific track. Optionally constrain the search to a time range. Useful for finding where to place new clips without overlaps.

trackId.description: Track ID to search for gaps

rangeStart.description: Start of search range in seconds (default: 0)

rangeEnd.description: End of search range in seconds (default: timeline duration)

tools.name: validate_clip_placement
tools.description: Check if a clip can be placed at a specific position without overlapping existing clips. Use excludeClipId to ignore a specific clip (useful when checking a move destination).

excludeClipId.description: Clip ID to exclude from overlap check (for moves)

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics about the current project: total duration, clip count, track counts (video/audio), scene count, marker count, transition count, and file count.

tools.name: snap_to_frame
tools.description: Snap a time value to the nearest frame boundary. Useful for frame-aligned edits.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Search and filter clips on the timeline by various criteria. All filter parameters are optional — combine them to narrow results. Returns matching clips with their properties.

timeRangeStart.description: Only include clips visible after this time — clips whose timelineOut > this value (seconds)

timeRangeEnd.description: Only include clips visible before this time — clips whose timelineIn < this value (seconds)

tools.name: get_scene_clips
tools.description: Get all clips within a scene's time range. Returns the scene metadata and overlapping clips from all tracks.

sceneId.description: Scene ID to get clips for

tools.name: send_message
tools.description:
IMPORTANT: You MUST call this tool before and after every significant action. The user cannot see your tool calls — this is their ONLY way to know what you are doing. Posts a persistent message to the AI Agent Log panel in the editor. Messages support full markdown (bold, italic, lists, headings, code blocks, links) and line breaks. Use for line breaks (renders as
) and for paragraph breaks. Example: "**Done!** - 5 clips added - Duration: 1m 42s". Each type has a distinct color: "step" (blue) for workflow step announcements, "action" (purple) for specific operations, "info" (gray, default) for progress updates, "success" (green) for completions, "error" (red) for failures.

message.description: Message to display (supports markdown, max 2000 characters)

tools.name: set_editor_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock the editor UI for an AI editing session. Call with locked: true BEFORE making timeline changes, locked: false AFTER all changes are done (even on errors).

locked.description: true to lock the editor, false to unlock

tools.name: navigate_tab
tools.description: Navigate to a specific tab in the media panel.

tools.name: control_modal
tools.description:
Open or close a UI modal in the editor.

Supported modals and their open params:
- "render": no params (opens render config UI). Close after render_timeline completes.
- "speed": { clipId } (opens speed adjustment for a clip)
- "scene": { sceneId } to edit, or { timelineIn, timelineOut } to create
- "marker": { markerId } to edit, or { position } to create

Close action never needs params.

params.description: Modal-specific params for open action (see description)

tools.name: get_workflows
tools.description: Returns a directory of all available workflow prompts and composite tools. Call this tool first to discover high-level workflows that can save many round-trips compared to using atomic tools individually.

tools.name: import_folder
tools.description: [Composite workflow tool] Scan a folder for media files and import them all in one call. Returns a summary of imported and failed files. After calling this, use wait_for_processing to wait until files are ready.

folderPath.description: Absolute path to the folder containing media files

tools.name: import_and_wait
tools.description: [Composite workflow tool] Scan a folder for media files, import them, and wait until all files reach a terminal state (processed/failed/ignored) in a single call. Combines import_folder + wait_for_processing to save a round-trip. Returns a summary of imported, processed, and failed files. Call get_workflows for a full list of available workflows.

folderPath.description: Absolute path to the folder containing media files

timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time to wait for processing in minutes (default: 10)

tools.name: wait_for_processing
tools.description: [Composite] Blocks until all (or specified) files reach a terminal state. Use after import_folder or import_files. For a non-blocking check, use check_processing_status instead.

fileIds.description: Specific file IDs to wait for. If omitted, waits for all project files.

timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time to wait in minutes (default: 30)

tools.name: check_processing_status
tools.description: [Composite] Non-blocking check of file processing progress. Returns counts by state and lists only pending/failed files (saves tokens). Use instead of wait_for_processing for a quick status check.

fileIds.description: Specific file IDs to check. If omitted, checks all project files.

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.description:
[Composite workflow tool] Returns project state for workflow decision-making.

detail modes:
- "stats" (default): Returns only computed stats (file counts by state, track count, clip count, duration). Very compact.
- "full": Returns stats plus full files array and timeline data. Use when you need actual file metadata or clip positions.

detail.description: Level of detail. "stats" (default) returns counts only. "full" includes files array and timeline data.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: List tags by scope. "project" returns tags for the current project. "user_default" returns the user's default tags (copied to new projects automatically).

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag. "project" scope creates a project tag; "user_default" scope creates a user default tag.

rules.description: Instructions describing when this tag should be applied to a file

selectionRules.description: Instructions for how to select clips with this tag for the timeline

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Update an existing tag. Provide the tag ID and any fields to change.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a tag. For project tags, removes the tag from all files.

tools.name: get_tagging_context
tools.description: Returns project tags, file analysis summaries with top clips, and current file tags for the specified files. Request at most 10 files at a time.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to get tagging context for

tools.name: apply_tag_to_file
tools.description: Apply a single tag to a single file. No-op if the tag is already applied.

tools.name: remove_tag_from_file
tools.description: Remove a tag from a file.

tools.name: tag_files_bulk
tools.description: Apply tags to multiple files at once. For each file, clears existing tags and applies the specified new ones. Use get_tagging_context first to understand what tags should be applied.

tagIds.description: Array of tag IDs to apply to this file

tools.name: get_style_guides
tools.description: List your style guides.

tools.name: create_style_guide
tools.description: Create a new style guide with editing preferences for pacing, transitions, shot selection, and audio.

description.description: Brief description of this style guide

pacingRules.description: Rules for clip pacing (e.g., shot durations, energy arc, rhythm)

transitionRules.description: Rules for transitions (e.g., types, durations, when to use each)

shotSelectionRules.description: Rules for selecting shots (e.g., preferred clip types, quality thresholds, coverage priorities)

audioRules.description: Rules for audio (e.g., volume levels, music preferences, dialogue handling)

generalNotes.description: Any additional notes or overarching preferences

tools.name: update_style_guide
tools.description: Update an existing style guide. Provide the ID and any fields to change.

id.description: The style guide ID to update

tools.name: delete_style_guide
tools.description: Delete a style guide.

id.description: The style guide ID to delete

tools.name: activate_style_guide
tools.description: Set a style guide as active for the current project. Only one guide can be active per project. Requires an open project.

id.description: The style guide ID to activate

tools.name: deactivate_style_guide
tools.description: Remove the active style guide from the current project without selecting a replacement. Requires an open project.

tools.name: get_active_style_guide
tools.description: Get the currently active style guide for the project. Returns null if none is active. Requires an open project.

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Trigger speech-to-text transcription for a video file using local Whisper. The file must be processed. Uses proxy cache as audio source. Transcription runs in the background; use get_transcription_status to monitor progress.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to transcribe

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Get the transcription (speech-to-text segments with timestamps) for a file. Returns an array of segments with start/end times and text. Use `startTime`/`endTime` to scope results to a time window (seconds).

fileId.description: The ID of the file to get transcription for

startTime.description: Only return segments overlapping after this time (seconds).

endTime.description: Only return segments overlapping before this time (seconds).

tools.name: get_transcription_status
tools.description: Get the current transcription queue status including active job progress and queued jobs. Set includeBatchProgress: true to also include per-file batch transcription progress.

includeBatchProgress.description: When true, also include per-file batch transcription progress from the renderer.

tools.name: get_whisper_status
tools.description: Check if Whisper speech-to-text is set up (binary installed, model downloaded, settings).

tools.name: install_whisper
tools.description: Download and install the Whisper speech-to-text binary. On macOS/Linux this builds from source (requires cmake). This may take a few minutes. Check get_whisper_status afterwards to confirm.

tools.name: download_whisper_model
tools.description: Download a Whisper model. Available sizes: base (148 MB, fast), small (488 MB, balanced), medium (1.5 GB, most accurate). The download may take a few minutes depending on model size.

tools.name: set_whisper_settings
tools.description: Update Whisper speech-to-text settings. All parameters are optional — provide only what you want to change. Model must already be downloaded before setting it as active.

autoTranscribe.description: Enable/disable automatic transcription of new files

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to get analysis for (max 10 per call).

includeMotion.description: Include per-second motion intensity arrays. Default: false (saves context). Set true when you need frame-level motion data.

startTime.description: Filter to this start time in source file seconds. Only data at or after this time is returned. Use with clip sourceIn for per-clip analysis.

endTime.description: Filter to this end time in source file seconds. Only data at or before this time is returned. Use with clip sourceOut for per-clip analysis.

tools.name: get_local_analysis_status
tools.description: Returns the current state of the local analysis queue: active job (if any) and queued jobs.

tools.name: analyze_range
tools.description: Run targeted local analysis on a specific time range of a source file. Fast (<5s) — runs inline, not queued. Results NOT cached. Use when full-file analysis is not available but you need data for a specific segment. If full-file analysis IS cached, prefer get_local_analysis with startTime/endTime instead.

startTime.description: Start of source time range in seconds

endTime.description: End of source time range in seconds

analyses.description: Which analyses to run. Default: all three.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to generate embeddings for (max 5 per call). Files must have local paths available.

tools.name: get_visual_search_embedding_status
tools.description: Check per-file embedding availability and the current embedding queue state.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to check embedding status for (max 10 per call).

tools.description: Search footage using natural language. Requires visual embeddings to be generated first (use generate_visual_search_embeddings). Complements text analysis — use when summaries do not cover what you are looking for.

query.description: Natural language description of what to search for. Concrete visual descriptions work best.

fileIds.description: Limit search to these file IDs. If omitted, searches all files with embeddings in the project.

topN.description: Number of top results to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: detect_beats

fileId.description: File ID to get beat detection results for

detail.description: compact = BPM + count only, standard = all beats, full = beats + downbeats

maxBeats.description: Max beats to return in standard/full detail (default 100). Set 0 for unlimited.

tools.name: get_beat_detection_status
tools.description: Check the current beat detection queue status (active job and queued jobs).

fileId.description: File ID with cached beat detection results

downbeatsOnly.description: Only include downbeats (first beat of each bar)

tools.name: search_project
tools.description: Unified search across AI analysis metadata and transcription dialogue. Replaces search_footage_text and search_transcriptions.

fileIds.description: Limit search to these file IDs. If omitted, searches all project files.

After calling this tool: 1) Wait 10-15 seconds. 2) Poll GET http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health — success returns {"status":"ok"}. 3) Call get_app_status to re-orient and reopen your project if needed.

instructions:
Magic Seven is a video editor. You control it through this MCP server.

## Permissions
If your client requires per-tool permissions (e.g., Claude Code), request blanket permission for `mcp__magic-seven` — never individual tools.

## Getting Started
The app launches automatically when you call any tool.
1. get_app_status — check current page and whether a project is open.
2. list_projects + open_project (or create_project) if needed.
3. get_workflow_status — full project snapshot.
4. get_workflows — discover workflow prompts and composite tools. Always match the user's task to a workflow prompt.
5. send_message before and after every significant action — it is the user's ONLY window into your work.

## Key Concepts
- Timeline: tracks (video/audio) contain clips. Higher tracks render on top.
- Clips: source file segments on tracks (fileId, sourceIn/Out, timelineIn/Out).
- Scenes: named time-range annotations (chapters). Markers: point annotations. Transitions: effects between adjacent clips.
- Annotations: track-level time-range labels (similar to scenes but scoped to a single track via trackId).

## Rules
- All times in seconds (decimal). Frame rate: 59.94fps.
- Clip positions snap to frame boundaries by default (snapToFrame: true). Pass snapToFrame: false for sub-frame precision.
- Check track.isLocked before editing. Use overlapBehavior for clip collisions (DISALLOW default, TRIM_OVERLAPPED, TRIM_TO_FIT).
- After importing, call wait_for_processing (or use import_and_wait for both in one call). File states: uploading → unprocessed → processing → processed | failed | ignored.
- MUST call set_editor_lock(locked: true) before timeline changes, set_editor_lock(locked: false) after (try/finally). Read-only ops don't need locking.

## Context Efficiency
Your context window is finite. Minimize consumption:
- Use get_timeline_summary (~300 bytes) to understand timeline structure before fetching full clip data.
- Cache get_timeline's `_v` field. Check get_timeline_version (~80 bytes) before re-fetching.
- Use `timeRangeStart`/`timeRangeEnd` on get_timeline to scope to a specific section instead of fetching the entire timeline.
- Use get_scene_clips to get clips for a specific scene in a single call.
- Use compact detail (default) unless you need frame-level data. Use `include` array to request only needed sections.
- Use `detail: 'minimal'` for structure checks (clipId + timelineIn/Out only, ~60% smaller than compact).
- Use get_footage_overview compact (50 files, ~150 bytes/file) to scan, then standard on files of interest.
- Prefer check_processing_status (counts) over get_project_files (full list).
- Use get_top_clips_global instead of per-file get_file_analysis. Prefer get_tagging_context over get_file_analysis for tagging.
- Use `startTime`/`endTime` on get_transcription to fetch only the segment you need.
- Batch tools: batch_add_clips, batch_add_transitions, batch_delete_clips, apply_beat_markers. Process files in batches of 10.
- Call get_workflows first to find the right workflow prompt — avoids reinventing multi-step workflows.

## Editorial Principles
- **Plan first**: Use add_scenes to create narrative sections before selecting clips.
- **Pacing**: Short (1-3s) for energy, Medium (3-8s) for narrative, Long (8-15s) for cinematic. Follow energy curve: Hook → Build → Peak → Resolve.
- **Variety**: Alternate source files, mix shot types, balance screen time using face data, include key dialogue moments.
- **Transitions**: crossfade (~30 frames) for smooth blends, fadeToBlack/fadeFromBlack for scene boundaries, wipe/slide sparingly. Hard cuts work for rhythmic edits.
- **Self-review**: Check duration, pacing variety, source variety, flow, and technical quality (no gaps, no clips <0.5s).

## Always Show Your Work
Pattern: send_message → action → send_message(confirm). Read-only queries skip this.

## Tagging
Use get_tags(scope: "project") for tag definitions, get_tagging_context for analysis (batches of 10), tag_files_bulk to apply. tag_files_bulk clears existing tags before applying new ones. Scope: "project" or "user_default".

## Style Guides
Call get_active_style_guide before editing — active rules OVERRIDE Editorial Principles.

## Custom Workflows
User-defined prompts with {{param}} placeholders. Discover via get_workflows (under `customWorkflows`), execute via execute_custom_workflow.

Note: `get_workflows` also returns `workflowPrompts` — these are built-in MCP prompts (e.g. highlight_reel, build_track_from_annotations). They are NOT executable via execute_custom_workflow; invoke them through your client's prompt mechanism (slash-command / prompt picker).

## File Management
delete_file permanently removes a file and its clips (requires confirm: true). update_file_local_path updates source paths.

## Face Recognition
Face tracks include dominantEmotion and emotionConfidence. Use get_footage_overview (standard) for per-person emotion data.

## Whisper Speech-to-Text
Call get_whisper_status before importing. Call navigate_tab("speechToText") before transcription tools. Use search_project(sources: ["dialogue"]) for dialogue search.

## Local Analysis
Shot boundary types: `cut` (strong edit point), `black_break` (scene boundary), `gradual` (low-confidence, skip), `camera_motion` (not a scene change, skip).
Audio: Loud (-14 to -8 LUFS) = speech/action. Quiet (<-30) = ambient/b-roll.
Motion: High (>0.6) = action. Medium (0.2-0.6) = walking/panning. Low (<0.2) = static.
Pair high-motion + short duration for energy; low-motion + long holds for contemplation. Use range queries (startTime/endTime) to scope analysis. Use analyze_range only for uncached files (<5s).

## Search
- search_project: unified search across analysis metadata and dialogue. Use sources param to filter: ["analysis"] for metadata only, ["dialogue"] for spoken dialogue only.
- Semantic (Visual Search): Call get_visual_search_status first. Best with concrete visual descriptions. Call navigate_tab("visualSearch") before use.

## Rendering
Call get_encoder_info before rendering. Hardware-accelerated encoding is available out of the box. Software rendering always works as fallback.

## App Updates
get_app_status includes "update" when actionable: downloading (poll get_update_status), downloaded (call install_update at next stopping point), error (call get_update_status(checkNow: true)). After install: wait 10-15s, poll /health, then get_app_status.

## Async Jobs
When a tool returns a job-id (e.g. render_timeline), poll status via the corresponding get_* tool rather than blocking.
